text: wet cooling tower + free cooling (baseline) (2D-3000m-boiler-electric-chp-tower-fc, R0038): accept. Centrifugal wet tower with free cooling cuts LCOE from 40.70 to 39.84 EUR/MWh and CO2 from 5304 to 4789 t/yr versus the legacy chiller, at the cost of 42120 m3/yr of tower water.

screw dry cooler + free cooling (water-free) (2D-3000m-boiler-electric-chp-screw-fc, R0044): alternative. LCOE 39.76 vs 39.84 EUR/MWh (0.2 % cheaper) but 4925 vs 4789 t CO2/yr and no cooling water; worth reporting as the water-free variant.

outage scheduled on the coldest day (stress test) (2D-3000m-boiler-electric-chp-tower-fc, R0043): alternative. Forcing the 35-day outage to start on the 28 Jan peak day still meets all demand with LCOE 43.43 EUR/MWh and 5967 t CO2/yr, so the backup boiler covers the trip.

Client CO2 valuation: 100 EUR/t on top of the 80 EUR/t already in the cost curve, i.e. co2_price_eur_per_t = 180 in all runs from this session on. Weather: measured Amsterdam Schiphol year used for free cooling / dry cooler.

Recommended plant (R0038): 2 doublets at 3000 m, gas boiler upgrade to 100 degC, CHP on co-produced gas, centrifugal wet cooling tower with free cooling. LCOE 39.84 EUR/MWh, 4789 t CO2/yr at 180 EUR/t CO2, all hard rules met, 42120 m3/yr tower water. Water-free alternative R0044 (screw dry cooler): 39.76 EUR/MWh, 4925 t CO2/yr.
